newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms San Paolo Bank ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms San Paolo Bank ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it had affirmed its ratings for Italy's Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino (San Paolo) at A1 plus short-term and AA minus long-term.
IBCA also said it affirmed the bank's individual rating of B/C and legal rating of 2.

"San Paolo's asset quality indicators remain better than average despite some deterioration the bank has experienced in recent years, in common with most of its domestic competitors," IBCA said in a statement.
It said profitability had improved in 1995 and 1996 and compared favourably in the Italian market, but remained low by international standards.

"Following considerable expansion of its assets and branch network, San Paolo's growth rate has diminished and management's recent focus has been to restructure and rationalise what is already the largest and most diversified Italian banking group," IBCA said.
"Management is now concentrated on increasing profitability to international levels," IBCA said.
